observations: Multiple boxes of 'SMART SOLAR TUBULAR BATTERY' stacked in a warehouse or shop.
The boxes are yellow and blue with 'SMART' printed in large white letters.
The text '220Ah' and 'SST-18220' is visible on the front and side labels of the boxes.
The boxes are wrapped in factory-style clear plastic film.
A 'Made in India' label is visible on the side of one box.
The seller's watermark 'JOHNNEX SOLAR SOLUTION' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows '220Ah' on the box; 12V is the industry standard for this model.
Photo 0 shows the brand 'SMART' and the description 'SOLAR TUBULAR BATTERY'.
No warranty card or official documentation is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The battery may be old stock with degraded internal plates.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturing date code stamped on the battery terminal or casing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as old stock with significantly reduced lifespan.

risks.risk: The 24-month warranty may be unenforceable or unofficial.
risks.proof: A photo of a stamped and dated warranty certificate from an authorized distributor.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge (sulfated).
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage and a load test.

proof_requests: Photo of the battery out of the box showing the terminals and any stamped date codes.
Photo of the manufacturer's warranty card, stamped by the seller.
Video showing the current voltage of one of the batteries using a multimeter.
response.reason: The brand, model, and capacity are clearly visible on the packaging, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case condition of the identified product.
